final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS z, si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin,0)) AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.healtheval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.z, s1.h, s1.r, s1.n, s1.r - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.a ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 10
